answer.reason: The verses tell of his charge over Solomon's levy and his stoning when Rehoboam sent him to Israel.

clauses.english: was set over Solomon's levy of men sent in courses to Lebanon
clauses.quote: and Adoniram was over the levy

clauses.english: was sent by Rehoboam to Israel and was stoned to death
clauses.quote: all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died

doubts: 2SA 20:24 and the Chronicles verse name Adoram/Hadoram, probably the same man, but under different names, so I left them out of the clauses and cited only 1KI 12:18 for the stoning, where he is Adoram.
